errors.description: For coprime m,n, the proof incorrectly states ell=m+n. In fact ell=lcm(m,n)=mn. The immediately following replacement (1,mn) and the rest of the argument use the correct value, so this is an evident, harmless typo.

parsed.notes: Apart from this typo, termination is established by a valid product/number-of-ones potential, and the prime-wise gcd-of-valuations invariant correctly determines the unique terminal value.
